name: Hans Helmudt
quote: I was fortunate. I was not looking for representation but the situation I was in impacted both me and a friend… Kyle listened to my concerns and seemed to go out of his way to handle my case in a way that made me feel comfortable and respected my ethical concerns. He was never pushy and always took the time to explain, in details, what was happening… If I ever had a question there was a number I could text. I pinned this to the top of my phone's messages app… I feel deep gratitude to everyone at Robert Hindin and Associates involved in representing me. They all did a great job and the outcome was better than I thought possible.

name: Karina Sodre
quote: I was represented by Robert Hindin at my first experience in car accident. I really recommend this guy because he is very talented and clarity every detail about my case.

name: Julio Barberena
quote: Kyle, Abby, and Ismael… All we had to do was sign the initial paperwork, and they did everything else. They got us to a doctor the very next day… dealt with the insurance so that we didn't have to.

name: Geovanny Moreno
quote: Felix is a man of his word and helped me get a fair settlement from an accident I was involved in. Communication was always on point and I was always updated as soon as there was any progress on my case. I 100% recommend Robert Hindin & Associates to anyone who are looking for compensation in accidents. Very honest and great people.

name: Matt Benson
quote: Fantastic attorney! Excellent communication skills. Knows exactly what he is doing. Would trust him with my case any time. Kyle is the best.

name: Kathleen Francis
quote: Excellent attorney… kind and compassionate human being. Which is the most important aspect of the business of law. In a world that is difficult to navigate, none better than this!!

name: Rob Cruize
quote: They made me feel like family… I was injured and trying to recover, and they took care of both me and my wife. They fought for us.

name: Chelsea Israelsky
quote: Kyle and Corbin were extremely helpful during a very vulnerable time… made sure the stress load was taken off of me as I was trying to recover.

name: Matt Fenster
quote: Kyle was able to help me out in a time of need and while he could not help directly he put me in touch with several other attorneys who could. Can't recommend enough.
